d: US Vice President JD Vance returned to his home state of Ohio for a final campaign rally backing Republican gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy and Senator Jon Husted ahead of the 2026 midterm elections. Calling the vote the most important midterm election of his lifetime, Vance urged supporters to turn out for Republicans. He criticised the Democratic Party over taxes, workers’ issues and what he called divisive politics.
